name: @cyphras/circuits
description: Cyphras private payments ZK circuits (Circom + Groth16 over BN254)

scripts.ptau:prepare: snarkjs powersoftau prepare phase2 build/testnet/pot14_0001.ptau build/testnet/pot14_final.ptau -v

scripts.zkey:verify: snarkjs zkey verify build/withdraw.r1cs build/testnet/pot14_final.ptau build/testnet/withdraw_final.zkey
scripts.export-vk: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/testnet/withdraw_final.zkey build/testnet/verification_key.json
